settings.heading: Track your order
settings.text: Every order is sent with tracking. Here's how to follow yours.

settings.title: Order confirmed
settings.text: You'll get an email with your order number straight away.

settings.title: Dispatched
settings.text: When your order ships, we email a tracking link for your country's carrier.

settings.title: On its way
settings.text: Follow every step with the tracking link, or in your account under Orders.

settings.title: Delivered
settings.text: Something not right? Contact us and we'll help.
